title: Nova Gift Emporium — merchant rotation
description: Gift Galaxy Retail stops transacting on day 8. Nova Gift Emporium, a 19-day-old account, begins two days later with the same payers, similar tickets and a settlement account that matches the predecessor.

edges.label: cohort continuity score
edges.note: Behavioural similarity and a handoff in timing support a rotation hypothesis. They do not prove common ownership; the shared beneficiary account is the strongest single lead and still needs human verification.

edges.label: low continuity
edges.note: Low similarity; shown as a control.
